gloss: to accomplish, to do, to make

definitions.explanation: To successfully complete or bring about something.
To make up or compose something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{偉業|いぎょう}を{為|な}した。
この{島|しま}は{火山|かざん}によって{為|な}されたものだ。
examples.english: This island was formed by a volcano.

examples.japanese: {為|な}す{術|すべ}もなく{見|み}ているしかなかった。
examples.english: I could only watch helplessly without being able to do anything.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{島|しま}が{列|れつ}を{為|な}している。
{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つの{努力|どりょく}が{大|おお}きな{成果|せいか}を{為|な}す。
examples.english: Each individual effort produces great results.

notes:
{為|な}す is a literary/formal verb meaning 'to accomplish' or 'to do.' In modern speech, する is much more common.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: Xを{為|な}す

REGISTER: Literary/Formal
This verb is primarily used in formal writing, set expressions, and proverbs. It's rarely used in everyday conversation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {為|な}すべきこと (what should be done)
- {為|な}す{術|すべ}がない (to have no way to do anything)
- {志|こころざし}を{為|な}す (to accomplish one's aspiration)
- 「{為|な}せば{成|な}る」(Where there's a will, there's a way)

NOTE: Often written in hiragana as なす or in set expressions.
